text:
sara: FYI staging canary image failed the new artifact trust check after yesterday's key rotation. saw it on ci-run-43 :/
deploy-bot: [alert] canary deploy failed: trust-check.error
  image: gcr.io/redwood/staging/runtime:2026-03-19-canary
  task: ci-run-43
sara: error log: `signature verification failed: signature not found for digest`
sanjay: hmm, that usually means the signing key used by the pipeline isn't visible to the verifier (kms binding issue)
mike: did the cosign upload step use the new KMS alias? last night we rotated alias `projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/cosign-v2`
sara: yeah pipeline shows `COSIGN_KMS_ALIAS=projects/redwood/locations/us/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/cosign-v2` in env
priya: can you paste the cosign verify invocation you used in the canary gate?
sara: we run: ```bash
cosign verify --key k8s://namespaces/cicd/secrets/cosign-kms-key --output json gcr.io/redwood/staging/runtime:2026-03-19-canary
```
priya: that k8s path expects the secret to contain a KMS-wrapped key reference the verifier can use. if RBAC on the KMS key was tightened during rotation the verifier serviceaccount might have lost `cloudkms.sign`/`cloudkms.getPublicKey` permissions
mike: i pushed a quick audit check: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ...` - the new binding only added `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to pipeline-sa but not `roles/cloudkms.publicKeyViewer`
olivia: aha. the verifier needs publicKeyViewer (or equivalent) to fetch the public key for cosign verification when using KMS-backed keys
sanjay: also we added a deny policy on the verifier SA last week as part of least-priv changes. maybe that blocks `GetPublicKey` call. i'll check the org deny rules
sara: for immediate mitigation can we rollback to the old key alias for verification? is the old alias still available?
mike: old alias `cosign-v1` still exists but we rotated and disabled it last night per rotation plan. i can re-enable for canary if we approve a short window
priya: re-enabling is fine as a short mitigation. but we need to fix IAM so verifier SA has explicit `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.getPublicKey` and `cloudkms.keys.getIamPolicy` rights scoped to the key ring
sanjay: agreed. i'll open a quick IAM change PR and reference the incident ticket (#INC-2026-317). will add auditor logs retention note too
olivia: we should also update the audit log filters so KMS GetPublicKey shows up in the central security logs (link: https://logging.redwood.internal/kms-audit)
sara: can we add a preflight check in the pipeline gate that runs `gcloud kms keys versions list ... --filter='state=ENABLED'` and `cosign verify --key ... --dryrun` before flipping traffic?
mike: yes, i'll add a dry-run verify step. quick patch referenced in PR 5384
priya: and we need an RBAC playbook entry: when rotating KMS aliases, run `iam-scan` against verifier and signer SA to ensure both have necessary roles. add to rotation checklist
sanjay: putting this in motion now: re-enable alias, trigger canary re-run, patch IAM with minimal public key viewer permission, update audit filter, and add pipeline preflight. ETA 45m
sara: :thumbsup: if we still see failures after re-enable, roll back the deploy and flag for incident
devsec-bot: incident created INC-2026-317: "canary trust check fail after KMS alias rotation" assigned to eng-security
deploy-bot: canary re-run queued by mike (ci-run-44).
mike: re-enabled alias, requeued ci-run-44
sara: ci-run-44 passed cosign verify locally but the gate still failed in the cluster job - error shows `permission denied /projects/redwood/.../publicKey`
sanjay: that matches deny rule. i found org policy denying `cloudkms.publicKeyViewer` for the verifier SA's folder. i've opened a temporary exception for the SA scoped to that key ring (policy change request PR 876).
priya: after exception applied, cluster gate succeeded, cosign verify passed, canary progressed to 10%
olivia: added audit filter and retention change in infra ticket INFRA-2223
sara: documenting action items: 1) Add RBAC matrix to key-rotation playbook; 2) Pipeline preflight & dry-run verify; 3) Audit filter for GetPublicKey; 4) Post-rotation automated iam-scan; 5) Revisit org deny policies to allow KMS public key reads for verifier SAs
mike: i'll follow up with a short retro doc in GH gist and link to INC-2026-317
sanjay: thanks everyone. lessons learned: key rotation needs both signer and verifier IAM updates, and org denies can silently break verification flows.
sara: closing thread when things stabilize. :white_check_mark:
